decision_needed.question: The General Fund budget schedule shows total disbursements of 7,713,846, but the statement (which also folds in the Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds) shows 7,613,925. The 100,000 difference equals the Depreciation Fund 'Transfer from the General Fund', and the report does not say which General Fund lines hold it. I inferred 50,000 in Instruction, 25,000 in Instructional support and 25,000 in Student transportation by comparing function totals. Is that allocation right?
decision_needed.recorded_as: Contra lines of -50,000 / -25,000 / -25,000 in General Fund detail expenditures plus an other financing item of -100,000; the basic statement totals are recorded as printed

notes: Modified cash basis school district, governmental funds only (no business-type funds; School Nutrition and Activities are in Other Governmental Funds). Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column of the statement of receipts, disbursements and changes in fund balances (trimmed pp4-5); the printed Total receipts 9,809,831 includes Loan proceeds 198,569, recorded as debt_proceeds (so receipts items exclude it). Roll-forward: 5,493,940 + 9,611,262 - 8,905,498 + 198,569 = 6,398,273. The statement's General Fund column combines the General, Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds (4,358,559 + 605,444 + 5,152 = 4,969,155 ending) and eliminates the 100,000 transfer, so the basic statement has no transfer line. Student support services 689,281 split into General Fund 326,818 (support services) and Activities Fund 362,463 (student activities); Operation and maintenance of plant 962,422 split into 644,061 support services and 318,361 capital outlay (General Fund 4600/4700 196,421 + Special Building 121,940). 'Other' 10,548 in the receipts list split into 5,000 / 323 / 5,225 using GF nonrevenue lines (p8). Balance sheet is the cash-basis net position section of the statement of activities (p3), Total Governmental Activities column; no liabilities printed, so liabilities empty and total_liabilities null. The school foundation component unit is not recorded. Detail: General Fund schedule recorded line by line with 'not itemized' objects (no program-by-object exhibit in trimmed PDF); budget amounts printed only on group heading rows (2100, 2200, 2500, 2600, 3500, 6000, 9000 etc.) are not attached to lines. Student Fee Fund (p17) is blank for actuals and omitted. Depreciation, Employee Benefit and Special Building funds have no printed total-disbursement line except where listed.
